title.en: Do not lose stripes to phase

t.zh: 单频探针在某些平移下没有响应，尽管条纹还在。补上与第一路相差四分之一周的测量，把两路作为同一个系数的两个分量。 <wiki-ref to="quadrature-components"></wiki-ref>
t.en: A shifted stripe can make one probe silent while remaining visible. Add a quarter-turn projection and retain both components of the same coefficient. <wiki-ref to="quadrature-components"></wiki-ref>

after.zh:
\[\begin{gathered}\theta_n=\frac{2\pi kn}{N}\\\mathrm{Re}=\frac1N\sum_{n=0}^{N-1}x[n]\cos\theta_n\\\mathrm{Im}=-\frac1N\sum_{n=0}^{N-1}x[n]\sin\theta_n\end{gathered}\]

两路投影都取平均值，并遍历整行的 N 个样本，得到同一频率的两个坐标；不是只采集两个原始点。单路投影可能因相位而为零，正交的另一方向补回了这部分信息。

\[\begin{aligned}x[n]&=A\cos(\theta_n+\phi)\\&=A\cos\phi\cos\theta_n\\&\quad-A\sin\phi\sin\theta_n\end{aligned}\]

频率 k 已知时，未知的只是幅度 A 和相位 φ，因此需要两个独立分量。在匹配整数频率、覆盖完整离散周期、排除常量频率 k=0 和偶数 N 下每两点交替一次的 k=N/2 时：

\[\mathrm{Re}=\frac A2\cos\phi,\qquad\mathrm{Im}=\frac A2\sin\phi\]

\[\begin{gathered}|C|=\sqrt{\mathrm{Re}^2+\mathrm{Im}^2},\quad A=2|C|\\\phi=\operatorname{atan2}(\mathrm{Im},\mathrm{Re})\end{gathered}\]

φ 以弧度计；A=0 时没有可确定的相位。游戏使用平均投影，所以系数长度 |C| 是 A 的一半。这两个特殊频率只有一条独立的实数方向，不能套用这条双倍关系；频率未知也不能仅凭这两个数确定频率。 <wiki-ref to="quadrature-components"></wiki-ref>
after.en:
\[\begin{gathered}\theta_n=\frac{2\pi kn}{N}\\\mathrm{Re}=\frac1N\sum_{n=0}^{N-1}x[n]\cos\theta_n\\\mathrm{Im}=-\frac1N\sum_{n=0}^{N-1}x[n]\sin\theta_n\end{gathered}\]

Each mean averages over all N samples to obtain two coordinates of one frequency; they are not two raw sample points. One projection can vanish because of phase; the orthogonal direction retains what that projection misses.

\[\begin{aligned}x[n]&=A\cos(\theta_n+\phi)\\&=A\cos\phi\cos\theta_n\\&\quad-A\sin\phi\sin\theta_n\end{aligned}\]

At known k, only amplitude A and phase φ are unknown, requiring two independent components. For an isolated matching integer-bin sinusoid over complete discrete periods, excluding DC (k=0) and even-length Nyquist (k=N/2):

\[\mathrm{Re}=\frac A2\cos\phi,\qquad\mathrm{Im}=\frac A2\sin\phi\]

\[\begin{gathered}|C|=\sqrt{\mathrm{Re}^2+\mathrm{Im}^2},\quad A=2|C|\\\phi=\operatorname{atan2}(\mathrm{Im},\mathrm{Re})\end{gathered}\]

φ is in radians; at A=0 phase is undefined. Mean projections make coefficient length |C| half the peak amplitude. DC and Nyquist have only one independent real direction and do not use this doubling rule. Unknown frequency cannot be determined from just this pair. <wiki-ref to="quadrature-components"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 用相差 1/4 周的两路投影测量一个频率。实部使用 cos，虚部使用 −sin，即 cos(角度+1/4周)；再给出系数长度。
brief.en: Measure a frequency using projections a quarter turn apart: real uses cos, imaginary uses −sin = cos(angle+1/4 turn). Also output coefficient length.

naiveWhy.zh: 两次相同相位仍只测一个方向，移动后的条纹可能被漏掉。第二路应当是独立的正交投影。
naiveWhy.en: Repeating one phase still measures one direction and can miss shifted stripes. The other projection must be orthogonal.

hint.zh: 比较同一条纹平移前后：一条投影可变成零，另一路应保留信息。长度由工具计算。
hint.en: Compare shifted versions of a stripe: one projection can vanish while the other retains information. Length is computed.

desc.zh: 保留指定频率的归一化实部、虚部及系数长度。
desc.en: Retain normalised real, imaginary and magnitude components at a specified frequency.
